Nirab and Sunerah pair up for liberation war film
2022-10-15T14:59:18+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/entertainment/tv-film/news/nirab-and-sunerah-pair-liberation-war-film-3143301

Nirab Hossain and Sunerah Binte Kamal have signed up for a new movie titled "Joy Banglar Dhoni". The liberation war film will be directed by KM Khurshid, and will depict the powerful tale of the fight for independence.

"Our liberation war has given us the freedom to live, breathe and speak freely, within our country. I have a weakness for movies which speak greatly about our tale of independence. I am hopeful that audiences will love it," revealed Nirab.

Chanchal Chowdhury leaving for the US

Nirab and Sunerah will be seen together for the first time, in this film. Both artistes have received praise from critics for their respective performances in "No Dorai" and "Omanush".
